0.0: The lighting is brighter, the mansion is clean... And yet, it feels like something is missing... Hmm, what could it be...
0.1: Oh, goodness! Of course, we never decorated #bCentral Hall#k. I was so busy ordering you around that I forgot all about it!

yes.0: There are #rGraveyard Stirges#k and #rJack-O-Lanterns#k in the #bAbandoned Graveyard# outside of the mansion. We could get some useful trinkets from them.
yes.1: Just bring me 10 #bSoul Flowers#k, 10 #bBlack Bows#k, and 10 #bJack-O-Lanterns#k. That's a modest request, I think.

no.0: Look, I know you're as stressed as I am, but I need you to focus and do exactly what I say.
